countInfo.Council_Name: Newry No. 1 (County Down) Rural District Council

source.title: Newry Reporter, 9 June 1949, p. 4 ("Notice of Result of Elections: Newry No. 1 Rural District"); Newry Reporter, 19 May 1949, p. 8 ("No Nominations")
source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: no nomination; the Returning Officer's notice of result names him in column 7, 'retiring Councillors deemed to be re-elected', and declares such persons 'duly elected, or deemed to be re-elected' (page image, Newry Reporter, 9 June 1949, p. 4); the Newry Reporter's 'No nominations' list names him for Mayo (Newry Reporter, 19 May 1949, p. 8)

note: Triennial election of the 14 electoral divisions of Newry No. 1 (County Down) rural district, one member each, 2 June 1949. There were no contests; no nomination was received for Clonduff and Mayo, whose retiring members were deemed to be re-elected. No nomination was received; the retiring councillor was deemed to be re-elected (Returning Officer's notice). Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
